package hybridapplication

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"time"
)

type Clock interface{ Now() time.Time }
type Service struct {
	Applications repository.HybridApplication
	Clock        Clock
}
type CreateIntentInput struct {
	IntentID             string                       `json:"intent_id"`
	ExpectedPathRevision int64                        `json:"expected_path_revision"`
	Kind                 string                       `json:"kind"`
	RequestedChange      domain.HybridRequestedChange `json:"requested_change"`
}

func (s Service) CreateIntent(ctx context.Context, actorID, pathID string, input CreateIntentInput) (domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt, error) {
	if s.Applications == nil || s.Clock == nil {
		return domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	intent := domain.HybridLearningIntentProjection{IntentID: input.IntentID, StudentID: actorID, LearningPathID: pathID, ExpectedPathRevision: input.ExpectedPathRevision, Kind: input.Kind, RequestedChange: input.RequestedChange, CreatedAt: s.Clock.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)}
	if err := domain.ValidateHybridLearningIntent(intent); err != nil {
		return domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt{}, err
	}
	return s.Applications.CreateHybridLearningIntent(ctx, actorID, intent)
}
func (s Service) GetIntent(ctx context.Context, actorID, pathID, intentID string) (domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt, error) {
	if s.Applications == nil || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(actorID) || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(pathID) || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(intentID) {
		return domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return s.Applications.GetHybridLearningIntent(ctx, actorID, pathID, intentID)
}
func (s Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, studentID, pathID string, c domain.HybridConsequence) (domain.HybridApplicationReceipt, error) {
	if s.Applications == nil || c.StudentID != studentID || c.LearningPathID != pathID {
		return domain.HybridApplicationReceipt{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateHybridConsequence(c); err != nil {
		return domain.HybridApplicationReceipt{}, err
	}
	return s.Applications.ApplyHybridConsequence(ctx, c)
}
